options.text: Check whether a fold along the dashed mid-line, or a turn about the centre, maps the design onto itself.
Decide by how attractive the grill looks, without naming a fold or turn.
Call the dashed mid-line the name mathematical symmetry.

parts.text: Give one reason for your choice.

stem: The diagram shows Gopal's square window grill with a painted inner square. He wants to know whether the design has mathematical symmetry.

part_answers.answer: Mathematical symmetry needs a fold or rotation that maps the figure onto itself, not attractiveness alone.

teacher.key_rationale: Symmetry is decided by a fold or rotation that matches the design to itself. Judging by looks alone omits that transformation. Naming the dashed line as the word symmetry swaps terms.
teacher.figure_note: Rewrote source right triangle as a square grill with inner square and a dashed mid-line fold check.
